en: Mayon Volcano in Albay province is famous for having the most perfectly symmetrical cone shape of any Philippine volcano.
The Cagayan River is the longest river in the Philippines, flowing northward through Cagayan Valley before emptying into the sea.
Mount Apo in Mindanao is the highest mountain in the Philippines, standing at 2,954 meters above sea level.
Palawan is the largest island in the Mimaropa region and contains the Puerto Princesa Subterranean River National Park.
The Philippine eagle is a critically endangered bird of prey endemic to the tropical forests of Mindanao and Luzon.
The Verde Island Passage between Batangas and Mindoro contains the highest concentration of marine shorefish biodiversity in the world.
Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park in the Sulu Sea is a UNESCO World Heritage site featuring pristine coral atolls.
The Banaue Rice Terraces in Ifugao province were carved into the mountains by indigenous people over two thousand years ago.
Baguio City in Benguet province is known as the Summer Capital of the Philippines because of its cool climate.
Lake Lanao in Mindanao is the second-largest lake in the Philippines and serves as a major hydroelectric power source.
The Surigao Strait separates the northern tip of Mindanao from the eastern islands of the Visayas region.
The Sierra Madre mountain range runs along the eastern coast of Luzon, acting as a natural barrier against typhoons.
